register: # ADDRESS SHIFT: the register column holds the Modbus PDU (wire) address, which is the vendor's printed register number minus 1 (SunSpec and Fronius number registers from 1, so the SunSpec marker 'SunS' is register 40001 and is read at address 40000). The rows in this file were shifted by -1 for that reason. To compare a row with the vendor document, add 1 to its register (for example Fronius lists total AC power as 40092 and it is read at 40091).

# CORRECTED, NOT JUST SHIFTED: manufacturer was already a 0-based address (40004); version and serial_number pointed at 40053 and 40061, which are neither the SunSpec Vr (40044) nor SN (40052) fields; and operating_state and event_1 skipped three temperature floats and were 6 registers too low (they are now St 40117 and Evt1 40119). These corrections come from the SunSpec float inverter model, not from APsystems documentation.

# DYNAMIC MAP: rows whose register column is [anchor+offset] are template rows. The anchors come from the SunSpec model chain the device reports (discovery in the protocol JSON) and fall back to the discovery_defaults in that JSON, which reproduce the fixed layout this file used before, so nothing changes until a device reports something different. The float inverter rows (models 111-113) are anchored on the model the ECU reports; the common-model rows stay at their fixed addresses. See documentation/architecture/dynamic_register_discovery.md.

note: Common model Mn (16 registers). Already a 0-based address in the original map; APsystems' manufacturer string is expected here
Common model Vr (8 registers). Corrected from 40053, which is the start of the serial number in the vendor's 1-based numbering
Common model SN (16 registers). Corrected from 40061, which is inside the serial number and not a field start
